examples.english: The team played the football match

examples.arabic: كان فريق الاسود يلعب ضد فريق النمور
examples.english: The Lions team was playing against the Tigers team.
examples.transliteration: Kaana fareequ l-usoodi yal'abu didda fareeqi n-numoor.

examples.arabic: سجل فريق احمد هدفا وشعر بسعادة كبيرة
examples.english: Ahmed's team scored a goal and he felt great happiness.
examples.transliteration: Sajjala fariq Ahmad hadafan wa sha'ara bi-sa'adatin kabirah.

examples.arabic: عندما سجل الفريق المنافس هدفا شعر احمد بالحزن
examples.english: When the opposing team scored a goal, Ahmed felt sad.
examples.transliteration: 'Indama sajjala al-fareeq al-munaafis hadafan sha'ara Ahmad bi-al-huzn.
